# Integrative Psych

> Board-certified psychiatry and psychotherapy services offering evidence-based mental health treatment across multiple locations with specialized expertise in ADHD, anxiety, depression, trauma, and addiction.

Integrative Psych provides comprehensive mental health care through a network of board-certified psychiatrists and licensed therapists across Miami, New York City, and Montana. The practice emphasizes evidence-based treatment approaches including CBT, DBT, EMDR, and ketamine-assisted therapy, led by specialists like Dr. Ryan Sultan with decades of clinical and research experience.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
- ADHD Treatment
- Anxiety & Depression
- Addiction & Substance Abuse
- Trauma & PTSD
- EMDR
- Ketamine-Assisted Therapy
- Medication Management
- Psychodynamic Therapy
- Telepsychiatry
- OCD Treatment
- Eating Disorders
- Autism Spectrum
- Mental Health Assessment

## Mental Health Conditions & Treatment

- [Adult ADHD Therapist | Integrative Psych](https://www.integrative-psych.org/specialization/adult-adhd-psychiatrists-in-new-york): Adult ADHD treatment with CBT exercises and holistic care by Dr. Ryan Sultan
- [Anxiety Therapist | Integrative Psych](https://www.integrative-psych.org/specialization/anxiety): Anxiety treatment with emotion-focused therapy and CBT techniques by Dr. Ryan Sultan
- [Depression Therapist | Integrative Psych](https://www.integrative-psych.org/specialization/depression): Depression treatment with emotion-focused therapy and CBT by Dr. Ryan Sultan
- [Addiction and Substance Abuse | Integrative Psych](https://www.integrative-psych.org/specialization/addiction-and-substance-abuse): Addiction and substance abuse evaluations with CBT, DBT, and psychodynamic therapy
- [OCD Psychiatrist](https://www.integrative-psych.org/specialization/obsessive-compulsive-disorder): OCD treatment with CBT and exposure-response prevention by Dr. Ryan Sultan
- [Eating Disorders](https://www.integrative-psych.org/specialization/eating-disorder): Eating disorder treatment for anorexia, bulimia, binge eating, and ARFID with CBT
- [Autism | Integrative Psych](https://www.integrative-psych.org/specialization/autism): Autism treatment with CBT and holistic care addressing ADHD comorbidity
- [Schizophrenia Therapist](https://www.integrative-psych.org/specialization/schizophrenia): Schizophrenia treatment with CBT and cognitive enhancement therapy
- [Psychosis Therapist](https://www.integrative-psych.org/specialization/psychosis): Psychosis treatment with CBTp and personalized care for psychotic symptoms

## Therapy Approaches & Techniques

- [CBT](https://www.integrative-psych.org/specialization/cognitive-behavioral-therapy): Educational guide on Cognitive Behavioral Therapy techniques and effectiveness
- [DBT](https://www.integrative-psych.org/specialization/dbt): Educational guide on Dialectical Behavior Therapy and emotional regulation skills
- [EMDR | Integrative Psych](https://www.integrative-psych.org/specialization/emdr): Educational guide on Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing for trauma
- [Ketamine-Assisted Therapy | Integrative Psych](https://www.integrative-psych.org/specialization/ketamine-assisted-therapy): Ketamine-assisted therapy approach with Dr. Ryan Sultan for neuroplasticity healing
